claims.candidate_meaning: The original speaker heard from the professor that Reviewer 2 said the method is not new, where the method is restricted to one whose concrete content, belonging to the group the speaker is in, is not disclosed in the original.

entailment.reason: Source says only that Reviewer 2 said 우리 방법이 새롭지 않다고 했다; the candidate adds an unstated restriction on the method.

evidence.quote: 교수님이 리뷰어 2가 우리 방법이 새롭지 않다고 했다고 전해주셨다. 난 동의 못 함.

claims.source_meaning: The speaker was told by the professor that Reviewer 2 said 우리 방법이 새롭지 않다고 했다.
claims.text: 원문 화자는 교수님에게서, 리뷰어 2가 원문 화자가 속한 집단의 구체적 내용이 원문에 밝혀지지 않은 방법은 새롭지 않다고 말했다는 내용을 전해 들었다.
violations: Added unsupported restriction: the candidate's 'method whose concrete content of the speaker's group is not disclosed in the original' has no basis in the source phrase 우리 방법이; the source gives no such qualifier.

claims.candidate_meaning: At the time of the original utterance, the speaker did not agree with Reviewer 2's evaluation, as relayed through the professor, that the method whose concrete content of the speaker's group is not disclosed in the original is not new.

entailment.reason: Source says 난 동의 못 함 toward the reviewer's claim that our method is not new; the candidate imports the same unsupported method restriction into the disagreement.

evidence.quote: 교수님이 리뷰어 2가 우리 방법이 새롭지 않다고 했다고 전해주셨다. 난 동의 못 함.

claims.source_meaning: The speaker expresses disagreement (난 동의 못 함) with the reviewer's assessment that 우리 방법이 새롭지 않다.
claims.text: 원문 화자는 원문 발화 시점에, 교수님을 통해 전해 들은 리뷰어 2의 평가, 즉 원문 화자가 속한 집단의 구체적 내용이 원문에 밝혀지지 않은 방법은 새롭지 않다는 평가에 동의하지 못한다고 밝혔다.
violations: Added unsupported restriction: the candidate limits the disagreement to a method whose concrete group content is undisclosed, which the source does not state for 우리 방법.
